fixture: Reuse addon-owned saved terrain, pavement controls and one sourced connected block; keep source DEM, masks, roads, architecture and QA layers independently regenerable
geodataContract: source URLs/dates/licenses/hashes, horizontal CRS and axis order/bounds
vertical datum/units/range/offset, source DEM resolution versus authored lattice spacing
sample dimensions and vertex/face convention, physical extents, world origin and tile seams
imagery/mask resolution and rights, stable source IDs and inferred/creative/HOLD fields
three independent native landmarks/separations, layer generator versions/config/seeds and invalidation dependencies

parameters.purpose: actual whole-map extents/resources/seams and representative load; not a polished-district-only test
prove visible stones/surface and camera/exposure repeatability before attribution
single intervention, same-location reversal and preserved heights/materials; stop if controls are insensitive
small matched surface/road versus overlay, unchanged footprint/cameras; no full-map fix claim
future matched 2m/6m representative lattice comparison only if warranted; source accuracy unchanged; LOD causation unproven
credible court/wall/setback/entrance/roof/street relationships, eye-level pedestrian/vehicle route and facade scale
complete road-to-bridge-to-bank pedestrian/vehicle traversal; source topology and landmark exceptions separate
risk-stratified tile-edge/slope/dense/open regression; report all required and untested cells

captureAndPerformance: raw native pixels, actual camera/FOV/viewport/world/environment/exposure and supported LOD readbacks; editor/GAME distinguished
ground routes with original actor/control identity, route progress, collision/clearance and ordinary-input evidence
pinned hardware/build/settings, warmup, repeated frame-time/memory samples, whole-map and block load; budgets declared before measurement
acceptance: Create one existing workflow job per stage; copy that stage's required assertions/cases and supply an addon-owned qualified adapter. Diagnostic source/import success never becomes visual/playability/performance acceptance. No native launches, road fix, resolution fix or realistic-map claim is established by this recipe.
